prompt: our CI suite fails maybe 1 in 5 runs and its always a different test. everyone just hits re-run until it goes green. this is driving me nuts, where do i even start
assertions: Treats flakiness as a defect to diagnose rather than recommending retries or reruns as the remedy
Names at least three concrete causes, such as fixed sleeps, wall-clock or timezone dependence, unguaranteed iteration order, shared state between concurrent tests, or real network calls
Explains why automatic retry logic makes the situation worse by masking real failures
Proposes a concrete first step for identifying which tests are actually flaky
Addresses test independence and shared mutable fixtures as a likely source
Acknowledges that a test that cannot be made deterministic should be treated as a known gap rather than quietly retried
